# McKernel control mailbox

This branch exists to keep one draft pull-request conversation open as the user's requested McKernel mailbox. It is operational correspondence, not a proposed milestone acceptance or a source change to merge.

The guardian posts a bounded explanation when work is blocked and polls replies from the verified phoenix-hacking account. GitHub's notification email can be replied to; the resulting pull-request comment is the instruction source.

Reply with `/mckernel-instruct` on the first line, followed by your instruction, to queue it for the current Root. Use `/mckernel-resume` on the first line followed by a concrete instruction to request a normal explicit continuation when eligible. Each original comment is handled once; send a new comment for a new instruction.

Replies are not shell commands and do not clear actual service, quota, permission, source or native ownership holds. Notification delivery depends on GitHub's email settings; the guardian records posting and reply receipts separately.
